posts.author: ToshaAngel
posts.body:
ToshA Building System
Version
: v1.0
Author
: ToshAngel
Overview
ToshA Building System is a comprehensive plugin for RPG Maker MZ that enables players to construct and manage buildings within your game world. With extensive customization options and flexible placement mechanics, you can create immersive city-building and management gameplay experiences.
Key Features
Building Mechanics:
Placement Options: Choose between grid-based or free placement for buildings
Categories and Variants: Organize buildings into categories with multiple variants
Activation/Deactivation: Enable or disable buildings based on game conditions
Map Restrictions: Control where building is allowed using map region
Resource System:
Building Costs: Set resource requirements for construction
Resource Management: Configure resources needed for buildings
Economy System: Create a dynamic economy with resource costs and benefits
Customization:
UI Appearance: Customize the look and feel of building menus and information windows
Building Properties: Define custom properties for each building type
Visual Settings: Adjust grid visibility, colors, and opacity
Integration with Other Plugins:
Weather & Time Integration: Works with
ToshA_DynamicWeatherTime
to enable buildings to produce and consume resources over time
Fog of War Integration: Combines with
ToshA_FogOfWar
to create strategic gameplay where buildings reveal areas of the map.
Download
